connector.name: Tinycontext
connector.registryDescription: Token-light local memory with SQLite hybrid retrieval for MCP agents.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image tinycontext:v0.2.0. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the tinysuitehq account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.
